idea-plugin.name: Terraform IAM Privesc Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Flags a Terraform aws_iam_role that can reach an admin-equivalent role through a real, whole-project AssumeRole trust chain -- not just an isolated wildcard statement in one resource, a genuine multi-hop privilege-escalation path (CWE-269), built by parsing EVERY .tf file in the project into a directed graph (role trust edges, managed/inline policy grants) and running a real BFS with cycle protection to the nearest admin-equivalent role -- the same graph-reachability idea PMapper/Cloudsplaining use against a live AWS account, applied statically to source before terraform apply ever runs.

Not a JSON parser -- jsonencode({...})'s argument is HCL map/list syntax, walked via brace/bracket balancing, same technique as this catalog's own Terraform IAM Wildcard Companion.

Stated honestly: v0.1 only resolves the direct HCL reference form (aws_iam_role.NAME.arn/.id/ .name) for both trust-policy principals and policy-attachment roles -- never a literal role name string, never an interpolated local variable, never a cross-account ARN with no matching in-project resource. A project with more than 300 .tf files skips whole-project analysis rather than risk hanging the IDE.

Free. No license nags, no telemetry, no network calls.

localInspection.displayName: IAM role reaches admin via AssumeRole trust chain
